caption: The template picker in SeedProd Lite mixes free and PRO templates; a banner offers 10 more free templates for an email address, which we did not give.
Our page in the builder with a headline, button and text. Optin Form, Countdown, Tabs and the social blocks carry a lock in the free version.
The Connect tab: every email marketing service, from ActiveCampaign to Mailchimp and MailerLite, is marked PRO in SeedProd Lite.
After Publish confirmed the page was live, the front end still said the content was empty or not saved.
The same page on the front end after we clicked Save once more in the builder.
Pricing on 22 Nov 2026: Basic at $39.50 for the first year for one site, normally $79; renewals are at full price.
